audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row said 'Akali' while both the full-layer why and content whys[6] describe Cho'Gath out-stacking her.
audit.why: Cho'Gath wins 56.22% over 699 games, the packet level chart gives him the 2-item row, and both prose fields on this entry already say Feast stacks out-size one shroud-E-R rotation. The enum was the only thing left pointing at Akali.
audit.corrected: 2+ items flips to Cho'Gath at 7/10, matching the prose already on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike and cooldown text tracked 'Twilight Shroud' with no cooldown attached and called Feast 'your committal tool'.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s — those two numbers define when she can commit and when she cannot leave. Feast is 80/70/60s.
audit.corrected: Windows keyed to Shroud at 20s rank 1, Shuriken Flip at 16s, Feast at 80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The interaction line stated 'Untargetable, but your W cone still silences her' but never said what the silence actually costs her.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable by spells and attacks, so single-target aiming fails, but Feral Scream is a cone with no target requirement and lands inside the smoke. The silence then denies W, E and R simultaneously — Shuriken Flip's re-cast dash and Perfect Execution are both ability casts. That is the decisive interaction and it was only half-stated.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream is a cone, so it silences her inside Twilight Shroud — that locks her W, E and R at once.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading text used male pronouns ('as he commits', 'his chip cost') for Akali and gave no mechanical content.
audit.why: Template bleed from another matchup. Voice and accuracy both fail.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in second person with the silence payload named.

audit.whatIsWrong: Don'ts entry 'Get Q-poked down' explained nothing about why the poke war is unwinnable.
audit.why: Five Point Strike is a 1.5s cooldown at every rank. There is no punish window on it — the correct advice is to refuse the poke war entirely, not to time it.
audit.corrected: Her Q is a 1.5s cooldown — she wins any poke war you agree to.
